path_title: Path 8: General Fallback & Extended Context Sources

sources.summary: Serves as a fallback for unexpected JVM behavior, undocumented bugs, and stack trace resolutions not covered in migration guides.
Provides specification for analyzing class-level and package-level dependencies to find unexpected internal API usages.
Details static analysis for scanning JAR files for deprecated or removed API usage.

sources.document_title: Java Language and Virtual Machine Specifications
sources.summary: Primary source for the Java Language Specification and JVM Specification across releases.
Comprehensive index of all JDK Enhancement Proposals for unmapped architectural changes.
Lists testing status of many FOSS projects against OpenJDK versions for third-party fallback resolutions.
Provides troubleshooting instructions using Java Mission Control and Java Flight Recorder for unexpected runtime errors.
